title: Dimension
statement:
The *Krull dimension* $\kundim X$ of a scheme is the supremum
of the integers $r$ such that there is a strict chain
$Z_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_r$ of nonempty irreducible closed
subsets of $|X|$. For $x\in X$, the *dimension at $x$* is

$$
\kundim_xX=\min\{\kundim U:x\in U\subseteq X\text{ open}\}.
$$

For a scheme $X$ of finite type over a field $K$ the finiteness
$\kundim X<\infty$ is recorded with the other properties of this notion, and the
computation of the dimension at a point $x\in X$ in terms of the
transcendence degree of
[def-kun-support] is [lem-kun-dimension-formula].

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against its only source, the master blueprint node (order 1674; slopmaster2 has no copy), and against the literature it transcribes, Stacks Properties Definition 28.10.1 (tag 04MT), which defines the dimension of a scheme and its dimension at a point as those of the underlying topological space, Stacks Topology Definition 5.10.1 (tag 0055); the statement agrees with both (strict chains of nonempty irreducible closed subsets, supremum of lengths, minimum over open neighbourhoods) and is kept unchanged. The two notions it is built from are now nodes: the Krull dimension of a topological space (new leaf def-kun-topological-krull-dimension, Mathlib `topologicalKrullDim` = krullDim (IrreducibleCloseds X), exact; it points at the existing leaf def-weil-irreducible-components for irreducibility) and the Krull dimension of a topological space at a point (new node def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point, Stacks 0055 (4), no Mathlib match, unsplit); schemes, their underlying space and open subsets are the existing leaf def-pc-scheme (Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme). Mathlib has no dimension of a scheme or of a scheme at a point; Artinian.lean applies topologicalKrullDim to a scheme directly, so the first notion specializes in one line, the second has no match, and the item is not a leaf. stmt_deps: removed lem-kun-dimension-formula (a lemma the last paragraph announces, itself stated with kundim_x X; a definition does not depend on a statement about it) and the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions (the blueprint's uses entry that the text never cites, import flag cites_outside_uses), replaced by def-pc-scheme and, for 'of finite type over a field K' in the last paragraph, def-weil-finite-type-morphism; kept def-kun-support, which the text cites for the transcendence degree. The last paragraph is commentary announcing lem-kun-dimension-finite-type and lem-kun-dimension-formula, not part of the definition; it is left in place.

lean.statement: noncomputable def topologicalKrullDimAt (x : X) : WithBot ℕ∞
lean.note: Both notions reuse existing declarations on the underlying topological space of a scheme: topologicalKrullDim X (Mathlib.Topology.KrullDimension) and topologicalKrullDimAt x (this module, with implicit {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]). The latter is the infimum of topologicalKrullDim U over open U containing x; this infimum is the minimum since WithBot ℕ∞ is well ordered and the neighbourhood family is nonempty. The last paragraph announces properties, not additional defining data.
